headline: SRI LANKA 🏛️ COURT 🧑‍⚖️ CONVICTS 15 👨‍👨‍👦 MEN 💣 Over EASTER 🐣 BOMBINGS 💥
text:
SRI LANKA'S 🏝️ HIGH 🏔️ COURT 🧑‍⚖️ has CONVICTED 🛠️ 15 👨‍👨‍👦 MEN 💪 who PLOTTED 🧠 the 2019 📅 EASTER 🐣 SUNDAY ⛪ BOMBINGS 💥 that KILLED ☠️ 270 🔢 PEOPLE 👥 and INJURED 🤕 more than 500 🧮!! Those FOUND 🕵️‍♂️ GUILTY 🧾 include NAUFER 🧔 MOULAVI who PROSECUTORS 👨‍⚖️ said MASTERMINDED 🧠 the SUICIDE 💣 BOMBINGS 💥 while NINE 9️⃣ other MEN 👨 were ACQUITTED ⚖️ and the whole COURTROOM 🏛️ got LOCKED 🔒 down with DOZENS 3️⃣0️⃣ of POLICE 👮 and COMMANDOS 🪖 DEPLOYED 🚨 before VERDICTS 📜 dropped like a CLIMAX 💦 after years of EDGING 🕒 the case!! "We finally got the RELEASE 🫧," whispered one bystander 👀 who was down bad 😩 for JUSTICE ⚖️ all along bro.

The COORDINATED 💥 BLASTS 💣 hit THREE 3️⃣ CHURCHES ⛪ and THREE 3️⃣ LUXURY 🏨 HOTELS 🛎️ making it the DEADLIEST ☠️ attack in SRI LANKA 🏝️ since the CIVIL 🪖 WAR ⚔️ ended in 2009 📅 with FORTY FIVE 4️⃣5️⃣ FOREIGNERS 🌍 among the DEAD ☠️ and most VICTIMS 🪦 were LOCAL 🇱🇰 SRI LANKANS 👨‍👩‍👧 including tons of CHILDREN 🧒!! ALL 🕳️ the BOMBERS 💣 died in the BLASTS 💥 themselves while INVESTIGATORS 🔎 blamed ISLAMIST 🕌 EXTREMISTS ☪️ and the 25 🔢 men INDICTED 📋 came from the MUSLIM 🕌 MINORITY 🧕 with one dude DYING 🪦 in CUSTODY 🛠️ leaving the courtroom BUZZING 🐝 like it just got RAILED 💦 by the long legal SESSION 🕰️!! "They handcuffed them in PAIRS ⛓️," said an intern 👀 watching the PRISON 🚓 BUSES 🚌 roll up and honestly it was kinda THICK 🍆 with tension the whole time.

ACCUSED 🧑‍⚖️ guys faced MORE than 23000 🔢 OFFENCES 📜 and arrived HANDCUFFED ⛓️ in PAIRS 👬 then got hauled into the HIGH 🏔️ COURT 🏛️ in COLOMBO 🏙️ using two PRISON 🚔 BUSES 🚌 while the session ADJOURNED ⏸️ before any SENTENCING 📝 could DROP 💧!! MOST ☝️ of those KILLED ☠️ were SRI LANKANS 🇱🇰 with many being literal CHILDREN 🧒 and they included CELEBRITY 🍳 CHEF 👨‍🍳 SHANTHA 🧑‍🍳 MAYADUNNE and her DAUGHTER 👩 plus an ENTIRE 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 young FAMILY 🏠 of FIVE 5️⃣ and at least EIGHT 8️⃣ HOTEL 🏨 STAFF 🧹 plus FIVE 5️⃣ from the same FAMILY 👪 in NEGOMBO 🏘️!! The whole thing left everyone DRIPPING 💦 with the weight of it like a marathon EDGING 🕒 session that finally popped off after years of waiting unc.

FOREIGNERS 🌍 who DIED ☠️ included ELEVEN 1️⃣1️⃣ INDIANS 🇮🇳 EIGHT 8️⃣ BRITONS 🇬🇧 and FIVE 5️⃣ AMERICANS 🇺🇸 along with CITIZENS 🧳 from AUSTRALIA 🇦🇺 BANGLADESH 🇧🇩 CHINA 🇨🇳 DENMARK 🇩🇰 JAPAN 🇯🇵 NETHERLANDS 🇳🇱 PORTUGAL 🇵🇹 SPAIN 🇪🇸 SWEDEN 🇸🇪 SWITZERLAND 🇨🇭 and TURKEY 🇹🇷!! THREE 3️⃣ of DANISH 💰 BILLIONAIRE 💵 ANDERS 🧔 HOLCH POVLSEN'S kids got WIPED 🧨 out at the SHANGRI LA 🏨 while the family was just trying to VACATION 🏖️ there and the BLASTS 💥 left a massive hole like an unfulfilled CLIMAX 💦 that the whole nation still feels deep down!! One witness later admitted "It railed us HARD 🍆" while staring at the victim lists that just kept growing longer and longer bro.

IN the WAKE 🌊 of the ATTACKS 💥 authorities ADMITTED 🗣️ a MAJOR 🏆 INTELLIGENCE 🧠 LAPSE 🔇 after PARLIAMENT 🏛️ heard that a TIPOFF 📨 from INDIA 🇮🇳 about the impending BOMBS 💣 was not SHARED 🤝 properly with SRI LANKAN 🏝️ officials leading to total FAILURE ❌!! In 2023 📅 the SUPREME 🏛️ COURT ordered former PRESIDENT 🧔 MAITHRIPALA SIRISENA to PAY 💰 MILLIONS 💰 in COMPENSATION 🪙 to VICTIMS 🪦 after finding him RESPONSIBLE 🧾 for NATIONAL 🏳️‍🌈 SECURITY 🛡️ FAILURES that directly CAUSED 🫱 the CARNAGE 💥 and last month TWO 2️⃣ former SENIOR 👔 OFFICIALS got SENTENCED 📜 to DEATH 💀 for CRIMINAL 🧑‍⚖️ NEGLIGENCE that LED 🛤️ to the BOMBINGS 💣!! Death sentences usually get COMMUTED 🔄 to LIFE 🧬 in SRI LANKA 🏝️ thanks to that decades old MORATORIUM 🚫 on EXECUTIONS 🪓 yet the people still march in the STREETS 🛣️ demanding full JUSTICE ⚖️ like they are edging for that final RELEASE 🫦.

The VERDICT 📜 arrives while a SEPARATE 🔀 INVESTIGATION 🕵️ into former INTELLIGENCE 🧠 CHIEF 🕴️ SURESH SALLAY is still UNDERWAY 🚧 with him ACCUSED 🧐 of ORCHESTRATING 🎼 the BOMBINGS 💥 alongside ISLAMIST 🕌 EXTREMISTS ☪️ and those claims ECHO 🔊 the 2023 📅 CHANNEL 4️⃣ DOCUMENTARY 🎥 that dropped WHISTLEBLOWER 🗣️ testimony saying the ATTACKS 💥 were ALLOWED 🫱 to happen just to BOOST 📈 the POPULARITY 📈 of the RAJAPAKSA 👑 FAMILY that ran politics for ages!! SALLAY 🕴️ who was ARRESTED 🚔 in FEBRUARY ❄️ denies every ALLEGATION 🗣️ while former PRESIDENT 🧔 GOTABAYA RAJAPAKSA who won election right after the 2019 📅 BLASTS 💥 on a platform of SMASHING ☄️ ISLAMIST 🕌 EXTREMISM also DENIES 🛡️ everything and he has been BANNED 🚫 from LEAVING ✈️ the country while begging the COURT 🧑‍⚖️ to block any potential ARREST 🖐️ tied to these ongoing PROBES 🔎!! Sri Lankans been out here for years holding regular DEMONSTRATIONS 🪧 screaming for closure like the whole nation got left HANGING 🪢 right before the big climax 💦.
